history.sg_progress: The Administration considers the recommendation to be implemented and had requested its closure during the Board’s final audit visit for the year ended 31 December 2023, following the issuance of the budget guide for the proposed programme budget for 2025 and the finalization of the budget fascicles for 2025. In order to improve the disclosure of information on all general temporary assistance positions of a continuing nature, the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget provided enhanced guidance to entities in the budget guide on the formulation of the proposed programme budget for 2025, issued in January 2024, as well as additional information (on grade, functional title, date of establishment and justification for the continued need of the position) in the supplementary information provided to the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions. The Administration looks forward to re-engaging with the Board during the upcoming interim audit for the financial year 2024 in order to agree on any additional information that may be required for the closure of the recommendation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board reiterates the previous recommendation that fully disclose and justify all general temporary assistance positions in the proposed programme budget, especially those exceeding one year in duration, and strengthen the monitoring of long-term general temporary assistance positions.
history.administration_response: The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget considers this recommendation to be implemented. As demonstrated in paragraph 10 (c) of the budget guide for the proposed programme budget for 2026, issued in January 2025, and in template 2 for the supplementary information to the budget fascicle, the Programme Planning and Budget Division emphasized the need for full disclosure, during the preparation of the budget fascicle, of information on general temporary assistance by requesting from entities more complete information on posts, including a table of general temporary assistance positions (both those classified as “finite duration” and those classified as “replacement”) encumbered for more than 729 days, in line with paragraph 20 of General Assembly resolution 79/257. In addition, the Division, in accordance with paragraph 20 of that resolution, introduced a key change into the budget guide for the proposed programme budget for 2026 by requesting entities to ensure that general temporary assistance positions were used to meet surge and short-term requirements, and therefore to propose the conversion to posts of general temporary assistance positions of a continuing nature (both those classified as “finite duration” and those classified as “replacement”).
history.board_assessment: Given that, under paragraph 10 (c) of the budget guide for the proposed programme budget for 2026, entities are required to provide an explanation of the continued need for general temporary assistance positions, which are then expected to be considered for potential conversion to posts, and a table of general temporary assistance positions (both those classified as “finite duration” and those classified as “replacement”) encumbered for more than 729 days, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
